dedupe_keys.name: berlin public green spaces including public playgrounds grunanlagenbestand berlin

description: Berlin's environment senate department publishes the stock of all dedicated public green spaces in the city, including public playgrounds, as a web feature service (the register describes it as 'Darstellung aller gewidmeten öffentlichen Grünanlagen (einschließlich Spielplätze)'). Coverage: the state of Berlin. Access: free WFS from the Berlin spatial data infrastructure, listed in the Berlin open data register (data updated 9 April 2026, released 21 April 2026). Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0. Caveats: the daten.berlin.de landing page served a JavaScript challenge and the gdi.berlin.de service presented a certificate chain this session's proxy could not verify, so the record was built from the register metadata only; attribute contents were not inspected. Simulation uses: green-space cooling and rainwater retention in urban climate and flood models, playground and park access, and maintenance planning. Related records: the Hamburg digital green plan, the Münster municipal green spaces and OSM leisure=park features.
